author: Slyon
quote: So I’m going to start by saying that the first game I ever bought for PlayStation 3 was red dead redemption, witch was one of my favorite stories in a game to date. Upon hearing that read dead redemption 2 was coming out over two years ago I had been hyping this game up ever since. So yes, my expectations for red dead redemption 2 were high.. after picking up my copy, that I had preordered almost a year earlier, I finally got to play the game. Guys just get it. By far the best and most detailed game I have ever played, hands down. Just an absolute masterpiece!
